project.name: Beta 2 · aligned
project.title: Beta 2 · intermediates on the centre line
project.blurb: Two Ø19 discs on Dual_Dial_Concept's dial centres, the movement centred on them, set by a crown at 3 o'clock on the movement, between the swivel lugs. The crown's worm turns a small crown arbor whose wheel turns the minute pinion; a transfer arbor under the minute disc lets both intermediates sit exactly on the centre line: minute pinion 12 → 18, pinion 11 → 22, pinion 11 → 22, pinion 13 → hour wheel 26 (exactly 12:1), so the discs keep true time against each other and turn the same way. 10 crown turns an hour. Module 0.6 (the 0.5 mm end mill has room in every tooth space), black delrin throughout, brass rods, bearings showing like jewels. Movement 45.5 x 32.4 mm, 13.8 mm from the back of the plates to the top of the discs.
source: Claude, 2026-11-23, from Adam's brief: the watch version of Hemistitch, hand-set, discs centred on the movement, crown at 3 o'clock on the movement to clear the hinged lugs, standard movement layering with the guts on show, a reliable machining tolerance; the case scaled to fit afterwards. Layout from a search over every rod, bearing, gear layer, the worm and the stem, scored on the box centred on the discs.

focus.label: Crown → E → minute → transfer → first and second intermediate → hour

rules.why: module 0.6: the 0.5 mm end mill has room in every tooth space

shop.note: black delrin throughout; fits are delrin placeholders until the press-fit test

arbors.name: Minute arbor
arbors.role: Turns once an hour; the minute disc sits right on its 12-tooth pinion, which takes the crown (from E's wheel) and drives the transfer arbor. Runs in plain delrin holes (under the disc), so the worm can lie close beside its rod.

arbors.name: Transfer arbor (B)
arbors.role: Under the minute disc's lower edge: its 18-tooth wheel (top layer) is driven by the minute pinion, its 11-tooth pinion (bottom layer) drives the first intermediate wheel, so both intermediates can sit on the centre line. Two pieces on one rod.

arbors.name: First intermediate

partNames.a1: First intermediate wheel and pinion (one piece, 1/8" delrin)

arbors.role: On the centre line, 4.5 below the middle. Its 22-tooth wheel is driven by the transfer pinion; its 11-tooth pinion drives the second intermediate. One piece of 1/8" delrin, milled from the pinion side.

arbors.name: Second intermediate

partNames.a2: Second intermediate wheel and pinion (one piece, 1/8" delrin)

arbors.role: On the centre line, 5.4 above the middle. 22:11 down from the first intermediate; its 13-tooth pinion drives the hour wheel 26:13. One piece of 1/8" delrin.

arbors.name: Hour arbor
arbors.role: Turns once in 12 hours; the hour disc sits right on its wheel (riding high on the second intermediate pinion so the disc clears it).

arbors.name: Crown arbor (E)
arbors.role: Takes the crown: the worm on the stem turns its 15-tooth worm wheel (in a pocket in the lower plate), and its 18-tooth wheel turns the minute pinion. Runs in plain delrin holes. One crown turn = one tooth: 10 turns an hour.

hands.name: Hour disc
hands.role: Ø19 black delrin, numerals V-carved and filled; on the hour rod at the minute disc's height, just above the hour wheel. Turns the same way as the minute disc (four reductions).

hands.name: Minute disc
hands.role: Ø19 black delrin, V-carved and filled; sits right on the minute pinion.

plate.name: Bench
plate.role: Just the bench under the movement; the plates are the drawn parts.
